label: polygonNeedsThree: help accepts a two-sided polygon (the count's low end moved down by one)
shiftSquaresToLarger: Shift squares the box to the smaller side
headAtEnd: the arrow's head sits at the line's start
find: return arrow(from: a, to: b, head: spec.head)
replace: return arrow(from: b, to: a, head: spec.head)

label: optionFromCentre: Option is ignored, so the box grows from the press
